source: Author requested creation of these three brainstorm proposals, October 15, 2026.

items.name: Ancient heat-exchange comb
items.purpose: A fan of impossibly thin black metal fins, partly fused together by old damage. Salvaged from buried machinery; an intact section might serve as a cooling component after inspection.
items.icon: A broken crescent of closely spaced black metal fins.

items.name: Ancient service recorder
items.purpose: A palm-sized, sealed capsule recovered from a war machine's maintenance compartment. It may contain fault records or fragments of the machine's last movements, if someone can read it.
items.icon: A blunt hexagonal capsule with recessed contacts and worn markings.

items.name: Ancient vibration-isolation mount
items.purpose: Two heavy mounting rings joined by an intricate internal suspension. A surviving example could protect delicate machinery from movement and impact, provided its fittings match.
items.icon: Nested rings with an off-center suspended core.
